market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver spot price is ~$34–35/oz as of March 2025; a rally to $120 in ~15 months would require a >240% increase, far exceeding any historical move, including the ~$50 all‑time high. The market’s 6.8% implied chance significantly overstates the probability of such an extreme, unprecedented event within the given timeframe.
evidence_points: All‑time high silver settlement never approached $120 (peak near $50 in 1980/2011).
Current macroeconomic and monetary conditions do not point to a hyperinflationary catalyst within 15 months.
Silver would need to more than triple even from recent multi‑year highs, a move without precedent in the modern era.
sources_consulted: CME Silver futures daily settlement history
